_readme: THREE TIERS, TWO VENDORS. Volume falls at each stage, so capability can rise
without the per-stage load rising with it.
poll   reads every new feed item, hourly
vet    decides whether a queued item is material or routine

deterministic corroboration scoring - counting how many independent feeds
carry the same entity in a window - which needs no model at all.
